newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady after choppy crude session.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady after choppy crude session.

text.p: NWE naphtha was slightly firmer on Tuesday after a volatile day spent chasing the changing fortunes of crude futures, traders said.
May swaps were quoted around $180/$181 in later trade, having traded as high as $182.50/$183.50 when IPE Brent futures were still in positive territory.
The June IPE Brent contract was trading 23 cents lower at $18.11 a barrel 1804 GMT, against an earlier high of $18.64.
Traders said the physical market remained very quiet with a number of traders offering small parcels in the low to mid $170s.
One player said such parcels should be considered as barges rather than cargoes, adding that a more realistic price level for physical naphtha cargoes would be around May swaps minus $1.0.
